stories.title: Gottheimer unveils two bipartisan AI safety bills
stories.simple_summary: A congressman is proposing new rules to make AI systems safer. These are laws that both political parties might agree on.
stories.why_it_matters: This is early-stage government work. Nothing changes for you right now, but rules like this could eventually affect how AI companies operate and what services you can use.

stories.title: AI's risk to humanity: Duke conference examines risks, guardrails
stories.simple_summary: A conference at Duke University brought together people to talk about what AI dangers we should worry about and how to prevent them.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly experts discussing concerns — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signs executive order to consider AI regulation, including proposal for 'kill switch'
stories.simple_summary: California's governor announced he wants to study AI regulation and is considering a way to shut down dangerous AI systems quickly if needed.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in California or do business there, rules like this could affect how you use or buy AI services in the future.

stories.title: A new kind of AI model from a ChatGPT inventor is thrilling developers
stories.simple_summary: A company made a new type of AI that works faster and costs less money than existing AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: This could make AI tools cheaper and more available in the future, which might help small businesses afford AI solutions.

stories.title: Newsom targets AI companies with new executive order, calls for 'kill switch'
stories.simple_summary: California's governor wants to regulate AI companies and have a way to quickly shut down systems that become dangerous.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're in California, this could eventually affect what AI tools you're allowed to use or how they work.

stories.title: Disney’s first CTO led an AI startup it once accused of copying its characters
stories.simple_summary: Disney hired the former leader of a startup called Character.AI as its chief technology officer — even though Disney once sent them a legal warning for allegedly copying Disney characters.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a business move between large companies — nothing that affects you directly.

stories.title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
stories.simple_summary: Google is building an AI helper that can manage your family's schedules, to-do lists, meals, and paperwork by sharing information between family members.
stories.why_it_matters: This could be useful for families who want help organizing their household tasks, though it won't be available everywhere right away.

stories.title: EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic quietly sets up biology lab as it ramps AI drug program
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, an AI company, is quietly setting up a laboratory to work on using AI to discover new medicines.
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually lead to faster drug discovery, but it's still experimental work with no immediate impact on your life.

stories.title: Dario Amodei and other AI leaders want to ‘Pace the Frontier’ but…how?
stories.simple_summary: The leader of an AI company proposed a plan to slow down AI development and have independent experts check if AI systems are safe before companies release them.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one leader's idea for making AI safer — nothing that requires your action, though it could affect how fast new AI tools roll out.

stories.title: Automattic’s 33-Hour Coup, and can AI labs police themselves?
stories.simple_summary: A story about leadership changes at a company called Automattic, and a discussion about whether AI companies can be trusted to police themselves.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to people who invest in these companies — nothing you need to worry about.

stories.title: Exclusive: US military had close call after using AI for false intelligence report, sources say
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. military used an AI system that made a serious mistake and gave commanders false information, which could have caused real problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI can make dangerous errors, and it supports the push for better safety checks before AI is used in critical situations like the military.

stories.title: Manus seeks $4B valuation in new $500M fundraise as it resumes independent ops
stories.simple_summary: A company called Manus is trying to raise money from investors at a very high valuation after a deal with Meta fell apart.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.
